markdown.markdown:
::: {#edu-exp}
:::

PhD in Mathematics with postdoctoral experience, specializing in ***statistical analysis, modeling, stochastic processes, and machine learning***.
I develop data-driven solutions that bridge advanced mathematics with real-world applications.
<!-- I enjoy applying mathematical rigor to real-world problems in AI-driven decision systems, risk analysis, and finance. -->

<!-- My background spans the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research, Indian Statistical Institute, and Presidency University, where I built a strong foundation in probability, statistics, and computation. -->

I have built Python-based machine learning models for ***credit risk assessment***, ***breast cancer prediction***, and ***image-based classification*** (computer vision), using algorithms including logistic regression, random forest, and k-NN.
<!-- I have developed Python-based machine learning solutions for ***Credit Risk Analysis***, ***Breast Cancer Prediction***, and ***Computer Vision (Object Detection)***, using logistic regression, random forest, and k-NN algorithms. -->
<!-- I have also built a [***TicTacToe playing AI***](posts/tictactoe-ai-2025-09-27). -->
I have also leveraged SQL for data extraction, cleaning, and transformation from large-scale datasets such as MIMIC-IV.

I bring a strong analytical background, coding proficiency, and a detail-oriented mindset to data-driven problem-solving across finance, tech, and analytics domains.

Based in Uppsala, Sweden.
Have a look at my complete [_{{< iconify fa7-regular file-lines title="File Icon" label="File Icon" >}} curriculum vitae_](files/CV-Mahbub-Alam-english.pdf) (for a Swedish version [click here](files/CV-Mahbub-Alam-svenska.pdf)).

:::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-8 style="text-align: left;"}

  *Tata Institute of Fundamental Research, Mumbai, India*

- **_M.Math_** (*Specialised in Statistical methods*), **2016**
  *Indian Statistical Institute, Kolkata, India*

- **_B.Sc._ in Mathematics**, **2014**
  *Presidency University, Kolkata, India*
:::
